items.q: This guy, Joe Boles, brought his equipment in, in Seattle. He brought his equipment in and recorded us live.

ctx.x: And many people started hearing about you up and down the Coast.
What brought that about, we made our first recording. This guy, Joe Boles, brought his equipment in, in Seattle. He brought his equipment in and recorded us live.
